addons.name: Stepwise
addons.tagline: Unsuspend AnKing one topic at a time
addons.about: A study planner for AnKing and other medical school decks. Tick the topics you're covering today and see how many new cards they add; check a topic off and its cards are unsuspended.

addons.name: Skim
addons.tagline: A card browser that keeps up with your keys
addons.about: Search with Anki's own syntax, then move through the cards with vim keys. Each card looks the way it does in review, and on a topic each suspended card says whether to unsuspend it now or wait.

addons.name: Exam Timeline
addons.tagline: A countdown to your exams on the deck screen
addons.about: Add your upcoming exams and see how far away each one is, right under the deck list and on each deck's overview.

addons.name: AnkiGlass
addons.tagline: Native macOS Liquid Glass for Anki
addons.about: Gives Anki's deck list, deck overview and review screen a frosted, see-through background on your Mac, with the toolbar and bottom bar in matching glass.

addons.name: AnkiBare
addons.tagline: Hide Anki's macOS title bar for a clean window
addons.about: Removes the title bar and window buttons and gives the space to Anki, while the window keeps its rounded corners. Pairs well with AnkiGlass.
